## Appearance

Grace is a striking beauty with the appearance of an angel, remaining as lovely as an image. She possesses golden-brown, magnificent curls, deep red cheeks, thin brown wrists, and golden-brown eyes. When required during the winter, she wears a faded old gray tam.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 CHAPTER IV. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000), +1 more_

## Personality

Grace is an outright tomboy who possesses a cheerful temperament and declines to brood over unpleasant matters. She is determined and decisive, taking immediate action once she makes up her mind, though she also exhibits impulsiveness and carelessness. While she harbors a quiet, private jealousy toward [Damaris Treleaven](../character/damaris-treleaven.md), any fits of rage she experiences are brief. She considers becoming a missionary as a means to view [India](../codex/places.md#india) or China.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P85](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0085), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## History

After moving to [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes) with her family, Grace Ashdown quickly befriended the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Along with her siblings, she helped shelter runaway [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) in a barn and parsonage garret. Grace later accidentally caused a village scandal when she and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) mistakenly beat carpets in the cemetery on a Sunday. To fix the situation, Grace interrupted a church collection to publicly defend her father, and she later rode pigs down Main Street alongside [Edmund Carrow](../character/edmund-carrow.md). Upon learning that parish threats to withhold financial support were putting her father's salary at risk, Grace personally confronted [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), winning him over so that he restored his contributions to her father.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), +29 more_

## Quotes

> "Ida, come and mix this while the table is being set by me. Should I abandon it briefly, the awful mixture is going to scorch. The time is nine thirty. Our arrival at Sunday School is going to be late."
>
> — Grace — [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P15](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0015)

> "Being me suits me better, as it is far more engaging. Jessie Drew manages a home as capably as her mother does, yet would you wish to share her lack of intelligence?"
>
> — Grace — [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P23](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0023)

> "The moment you begin to love a location, you get uprooted. I will never, ever, ever wed a minister, regardless of how wonderful he might be."
>
> — Grace — [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P37](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0037)

> "I feel the same way. Every one of us girls does. I intend to just stroll by without giving him any attention whatsoever. Keep your eyes on me!"
>
> — Grace — [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P21](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0021)

> "A point of honour is involved. Ida, do not you venture to inform a soul. Should you do so, I will refrain from ever sharing secrets with you in the future!"
>
> — Grace — [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P28](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0028)
